first_public_date_evidence: The accessible author-upload metadata for the focal Calvo–Grande–Grigorieff paper gives 2015-01-30 as a date-verified public digital deposit; the original paper appeared in print in 1990, but no original day-level public date is claimed.
integrity: Symbolic coefficient identities and universal positivity proofs are reproduced by the included standalone SymPy checker; seven rational monodromy checks are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. No independent audit performed.
limitations: Only exact three-periodic homogeneous zero stability for the genuine variable-coefficient BDF4 scheme is proved; neither arbitrary-grid convergence nor general ODE stability follows. The spectral boundary is neutral. Specialist literature access is incomplete.
title: A sharp three-periodic BDF4 Floquet threshold and singular-grid stability frontier
